purpose: Second optimization candidate after Candidate A produced acceptable profit factor, win rate, and return but failed the max drawdown gate. Candidate B keeps the guarded fallback entry model and tightens trade frequency and daily loss controls to reduce drawdown.
risk_profile: drawdown reduction candidate; not final live preset

candidate_a_reference.gate_result: failed only because max drawdown exceeded 12 percent

expected_effect.quality_goal: keep profit factor above 1.20 while reducing max drawdown below 12 percent

notes: Candidate A already proved the guarded fallback can trade profitably, so Candidate B focuses on risk compression rather than increasing signal count.
The strongest drawdown controls changed from Candidate A are MaxDailyTrades 12 to 8, MaxDailyLossMoney 5 to 3, MaxConsecutiveLosses 4 to 3, and cooldown 20 to 30 minutes.
If Candidate B under-trades or return drops too much, the next version should lower DeltaThreshold from 100 to 90 before loosening daily loss controls.
